newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soycomplex registrations to June 15--Abiove.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soycomplex registrations to June 15--Abiove.

text.p: Brazilian export registrations of soybeans, soymeal and soyoil to June 15 were as follows, according to the Brazilian Vegetable Oil Industries Association (Abiove).
Quantities in thousands of tonnes are for the marketing year (February/January).
Abiove expects soybean exports to reach 8.5 million tonnes in 1997/98 against 3.63 million the previous season.
Soymeal sales overseas should total 8.9 million against 10.80 million in 1996/97 and soyoil exports 850,000 tonnes against 1.34 million during the 1996/97 marketing year.
